description: Update routing (App.tsx), sidebar navigation (Sidebar.tsx), Dashboard KPIs, and enhance ProductDetail page with stock charts and movement timeline
steps: Update src/App.tsx: Add lazy imports for Transfers, Receiving, Adjustments, LowStock pages from src/pages/inventory/. Add routes: 'inventory/transfers' -> Transfers, 'inventory/receiving' -> Receiving, 'inventory/adjustments' -> Adjustments, 'inventory/low-stock' -> LowStock. Place within the existing protected routes section after existing inventory routes.

Update src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: Import ArrowLeftRight (already imported), PackageCheck, SlidersHorizontal, AlertTriangle from lucide-react. Add four items to the 'Inventory' section in navSections after 'Categories': { title: 'Transfers', href: '/inventory/transfers', icon: ArrowLeftRight }, { title: 'Receiving', href: '/inventory/receiving', icon: PackageCheck }, { title: 'Adjustments', href: '/inventory/adjustments', icon: SlidersHorizontal }, { title: 'Low Stock', href: '/inventory/low-stock', icon: AlertTriangle }. Note: ArrowLeftRight is already used for Stock Movements, so use Repeat or ArrowRightLeft for Transfers instead to avoid duplication. Check existing icon usage.

Update src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Add/update KPI cards in the first grid: replace or add 'Low Stock Alerts' (AlertTriangle icon, count + 'critical' indicator), 'Pending Transfers' count (ArrowRightLeft icon), 'POs to Receive' count (PackageCheck icon). Add a 'Recent Stock Movements' feed section (last 10 movements) with type icons (in=ArrowDownLeft green, out=ArrowUpRight red, transfer=ArrowLeftRight blue, adjustment=Pencil amber) showing product name, qty, warehouse, time ago. Use mock data matching the existing mock data pattern.

Enhance src/pages/inventory/ProductDetail.tsx: Add Recharts BarChart showing stock levels per warehouse (horizontal bars with warehouse names on Y-axis, quantity on X-axis, reorder_point as a reference line). Add movement history timeline section showing last 20 movements with type badges, dates, quantities, and references (enhance existing recentMovements section). Add 'Quick Adjust' and 'Quick Transfer' buttons in the top action bar. Add low stock warning banner (amber/red) at top if total stock < reorder_point. Import and use BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, ReferenceLine, ResponsiveContainer from recharts.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar shows new navigation items under Inventory section with distinct icons
Dashboard displays updated KPI cards and recent stock movements feed
ProductDetail page shows stock level bar chart with reorder point reference line
ProductDetail has quick action buttons for adjustment and transfer
Low stock warning banner shows when applicable
bun run type-check passes with zero errors
